Corollary
[Uniqueness in $W_0^{1,2}$] Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0192 1. ch8:8.2\group ch08-generalized-solutions If $u\in W_0^{1,2}(\Omega )$ and $Lu=0$ in $\Omega $, then $u=0$ in $\Omega $.
Proof

\sketch Apply Theorem 8.1 to $u$ and $-u$.

□
